scope: Exactly one reviewed continuation of Q10 embedding event12, preserving TLS verification, all old outcomes, cumulative counters and the three-attempt request ceiling.
authorization_assessment: The existing human instruction to investigate and retry the six failed DRIFT cells covers this reviewed exact continuation without raising limits or weakening TLS. This is a recorded manual exception, not a new automatic TLS retry category.

actual_official_engine_offline_test.input: Immutable real stopped-summary clone in a temporary directory; real frozen Data, graph, tokenizers and official execute_cell; fake transport for every new response.
actual_official_engine_offline_test.limitation: Synthetic answers and vectors verify execution and cache identity, not experimental answer quality.

verified_controls: Authorization requires the exact stopped summary and snapshot SHA and unchanged in-memory state. No original event or counter changes during authorization.
The exact event12 cell, service, stage, status, security-error category, key, body SHA and prior event list are checked. Other targets and duplicate authorization are rejected.
Pending manual recovery rejects any other new request before cell/request metadata, counters, reservation or dispatch are mutated; rejected requests leave a resumable ledger.

Production runner prefetches the exact authorized old embedding body before official Q10 replay. Successful reply enters the ordinary exact cache; no query, route, prompt, graph, seed or Local selection algorithm changes.
The manual permission is consumed atomically with durable event13 reservation before fake dispatch. Host loss after reservation without a complete reply remains unknown and stops on resume.

A second TLS/security failure stops after event13. If event13 instead encounters an ordinarily authorized transient error, only event14 remains, with 15-second backoff; no fourth physical attempt is permitted.
Permission/authentication/safety denials remain fatal; TLS verification, certifi, hostname checks and redirect rejection remain intact.
All twelve old event objects remain equal, canonical event12 bytes remain identical, old request/response files retain their hashes, original usage stays null, and Q08 stays complete and unmodified.
Review/source hashes, snapshot, old history and consumption linkage are checked; mutated snapshots, counters, request metadata, history and consumption are rejected.
Worker diagnostics add only filtered TLS class/reason symbols and integer verification codes. The broad TLS error classification and retry policy are unchanged.

resolved_findings.issue: Actual official Q10 replay can schedule a different Local embedding first, before the failed event12 key; reserving it would occupy sequence13.
resolved_findings.repair: Parent added exact production prefetch plus a pending-slot guard. Independent real-engine replay now confirms event13 is exactly event12 body, later reused from cache.

resolved_findings.issue: The first pending-slot guard placement rejected a new body after persisting cell metadata, leaving an orphan request that could not resume.
resolved_findings.repair: Parent moved an additional guard before new metadata mutation. The rejection-and-reopen negative test now passes.

limitations: The failed worker retained only transport_security_error, not the SSL reason. Later successful verified TLS handshakes cannot identify the old cause or establish that provider usage was zero.
dispatch_started is set before opener.open; it records entry to the dispatch boundary, not proof of provider receipt.

The private original run stayed stopped during this review. No production authorize/prefetch/worker was executed, no live-readiness was changed, no model or HTTP API calls were made, and no credentials were read.
Existing scores and historical failures are unchanged. Any later retry outcomes must remain separate from the original experiment.
